phase1_classification.kind_reason: Operation-level hallucination benchmark for memory systems with memory extraction, memory updating and memory QA tasks over user-centric multi-turn dialogues (HaluMem-Medium/Long, ~15k memory points, 3.5k questions); memory points cover persona, events and relationships.
